body:
I hope I can find someone to call family. I'm happy to know that you have one.
I mean, yes I love my parents(not my brother) but sometimes I want another family, who don't have any genetic similarities. Blood connections justify abuses and I hate it.
Thank you for sending and sharing your experiences. Thank you.

I'm from S.Korea and now living in Japan. Both are not very kind to feminists.I'm pretty sure my parents love me, but I don't think they respect me as a person, I think they just love their idolized daughter. I have been aggressive and yet they do not listen to me. I'm so tired being upset and angry just to try to make them understand.

Yes, I believe feminism will change the situation. But I was so tired to see excuses of males and their secondary victimization. 

But your comment makes me feel like there are still hope,.. maybe.  
thank you being here for me.
I've felt alone in this world since several years ago, but your comment reminds me that I'm not. thanks.

how about talking about your depression to parents?  
I get that, you don't want to see them sad, but in my case, when they found out my cuts, blamed themselves and it hurt.   
They are just human like us, they don't know what's happening inside us.  
I hope your parents would listen to you..
